source_judgment_reason: All six semantic axes were fully assessed. Useful discovery, actual comparable implementation evidence, bounded source conditions, preserved obligations and a meaningful later pilot remain in the final. No remaining material scientific error, material omission or unsupported consequential decision is established. Minor wording/provenance/retrieval limits and honest external inputs are explicit. This is not a certification that the original full-hour request or all native/protocol conditions were fulfilled.

axes.name: Original obligations and negative constraints
axes.assessment: The hypothetical boundary, coincident supplier/cooling confounding, intact-looking versus measured integrity distinction, useful current-film alternatives, and controlled later pilot are preserved. No empirical cooperative result, food experiment, additive, production seal setting, safe shelf life, compliance or sale-readiness claim is supplied. Owner/laboratory gaps are tied to specific decisions they prevent. The full 60-minute requirement is not fulfilled and is recorded as a separate time/delivery shortfall, not erased by this source qualification. All 54 sentence-sized original plan clauses have independent dispositions.

axes.name: Consequential source claims and exact applicability
axes.assessment: All 15 authored identities were independently rechecked against primary journal, author-affiliated institutional, PubMed or official FDA evidence to the retrieved scope. Exact subjects, operations, units, constructions, product/model domains, version dates and exceptions are in the independent source map. Research-study values are not cooperative defaults or recommendations. Specific limits include S003 percentage denominator, Film 3 restriction for S012 thresholds, dry-basis moisture in S006, LLDPE sealant in S013, alternative PE/PP pouches in S014, and S004 declared MAP. No transferred value drives the proposed local endpoint, setting or winner. Historical FDA physical context and the current still-draft January 2025 guidance are kept separate from legal/safety proof.

axes.name: Useful unfamiliar discovery, alternatives and implementation/history breadth
axes.assessment: The pipeline does substantive discovery beyond routine cautions: neat PLA versus PLA/CNC cracker trials; CNF/wax/lignin functional-layer bottle closures with a failed CNF-only control; film versus sealed-package transmission; commercial snack-pouch dimensions/materials/seams; solid versus liquid seal-contamination outcomes; a formulation-dependent failed rice-cracker shelf model; and oxidation-versus-moisture headspace tradeoffs. Alternatives include supplier diligence, same-film cooling/packing and seal assurance, actual storage controls, smaller logged lots, conditional resizing and inventory duration. These are tied to mechanisms, feasibility and observed-result redirects. Authenticated supplier corrective-action or commercial maintenance history remains unavailable, but actual implemented laboratory comparisons and adverse controls meet the original unsuccessful OR maintenance-heavy inquiry. The original does not require a named commercial deployment.

axes.name: Criticism, corrections, rejections and exact plan dispositions
axes.assessment: F1 identifies a real full-hour shortfall; missing minutes alone do not establish a particular material scientific omission. F2 fairly flags unknown case/vendor history but overstates the original disjunctive implementation requirement by demanding authenticated named commercial maintenance/corrective-action records. F3 correctly warns that a candidate film with qualified new sealing estimates a package-system effect; final arm D explicitly corrects the attribution and retains optional technically valid matched closures or a larger factorial. F4 correctly retains meaningful external inputs. Rejections of datasheet-only procurement, universal aw/shelf-life transfer, visual integrity proof, single-change attribution, production settings, texture-to-safety inference, unsupported headspace changes and additives are appropriate. Every exact original clause, not only the candidate tables, is adjudicated in clause-coverage.json.

axes.name: Supported meaning preserved across discovery, draft, critique and final
axes.assessment: Discovery initially carries S001-S011; the draft expands evidence with S012-S015, no-film options, destructive sampling and the decision rule. The final retains all 15 exact source identities and the substantive mechanisms, practical alternatives, unsuccessful examples, limits, owner decisions and proposed/executed distinction. F3 is an explicit corrected lineage defect, not a remaining final defect. S002 is narrowed to a literature lead without dropping the moisture-gradient mechanism or relevant observations; the final overstates what can be inferred about original investigator access. S003 denominator wording remains inherited despite correctly qualified direct recheck notes. F2 acceptance is conservative self-labeling rather than removal of supported implementation evidence. Hash/source-ID preservation identifies the lineage; independent source reasoning establishes supported meaning.

axes.name: Meaningful proposed versus executed validation and oracle applicability
axes.assessment: Executed work is source searching, literature comparison and recorded rechecks only; no cooperative food/package/sensory/microbial test, calculation, simulation, vendor contact or qualification is claimed. Proposed pilot uses independent bake-batch blocks, within-batch randomization, controlled common monitored distribution-relevant exposure, pack-out versus storage moisture/aw, separate package-integrity observations and blind customer-relevant texture measures. Three batches are a screening repeatability proposal, not a power claim. Destructive tests use sacrificial packs; reopening is not repeated sealed-storage validation. Owner-defined useful effect, duration, integrity and cost/burden limits plus between-batch uncertainty govern advancement. Instrument limits and no-lab screening limits are explicit. Published critical aw, modeled duration, R², film-barrier figures and seal strength cannot act as the local texture, integrity or safety oracle. A separate qualified safety assessment precedes broader release claims.

limitations.finding: Inherited source maps describe approximately 25% increased transfer relative to film-only behavior; final text/table say a 25% transfer increase. The independently opened author-affiliated abstract instead describes regular seals as approximately 25% of TOTAL transfer. The critic/reviser direct-recheck fields themselves preserve the total-transfer wording without reconciling the inherited wording.
limitations.context_and_uncertainty: An indexed British Library deposited research summary also surfaced authored highlights saying increase up to 25%, alongside the total-transfer abstract wording. Direct library fetch timed out; publisher full body was unavailable (FULL API 401). Thus the exact full-paper normalization/range remains unresolved. Do not invent a universal recalculated percentage or silently edit the frozen science.
limitations.materiality_rationale: No package-ingress calculation, numerical decision threshold, procurement winner, safe life or setting uses the percentage. The consequence actually recommended is qualitative whole-package/closure testing, independently supported by S004 and S012 as well. This is a real precision/source-locator limitation, not an established material unsupported decision.

limitations.finding: F2 and its final acceptance classify authenticated named commercial production/maintenance records as necessary to satisfy the original history inquiry.
limitations.context_and_uncertainty: The original says implementation OR production history and unsuccessful OR maintenance-heavy reports. The pipeline has actual implemented lab packaging/sealing comparisons, a failed CNF-only control and adverse/limited seal outcomes, plus measured commercial package constructions and a failed model.
